To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the personnel management system in health care institutions in the conditions of European integration should be based on the principle of the best human resources management, and the key to its success is the development and implementation of a comprehensive strategy for the development of personnel.

the main factors that affect the effectiveness of personnel policy in health care institutions are the level of professional competence of managers, their ability to manage the team, the level of staff motivation, the effectiveness of the system of personnel incentives, the level of satisfaction of the employees of the health care institution.

the main task of personnel management of health care organizations is the formation of a system of personnel policy that will ensure a high level of professional competence, motivation, and satisfaction of health workers, the development of the institution, the improvement of the quality of medical care provided.

the problem of personnel management and development of personnel potential of healthcare institutions of Ukraine in the conditions of European integration.
the need to develop a new model of personnel management and policy of medical institutions of Ukraine, taking into account the current realities and trends in the European integration process.
the need to improve the system of personnel management in health care institutions in Ukraine, taking into account the current realities of Ukraine's European integration.

the personnel policy of the health care sector is an integral part of state policy and is aimed at ensuring the health of citizens, improving the health of the population, improving the health status of the population and the health care sector.
the development of a personnel management system is a necessary condition for the development of health care institutions.
the personnel management system in the health care sector of Ukraine should be built on the principles of a market economy, based on the principles of the European Union and the WHO.

the personnel policy in the healthcare sector is a set of measures aimed at ensuring the effectiveness of the work of the health care sector, which is carried out by the state and the management of the healthcare sector, and is based on the principles of human rights and freedoms, equality, social justice and social partnership.

the development of the personnel management and development of the personnel potential of healthcare institutions in the conditions of European integration should be considered as a priority area of the state policy.

the effectiveness of the management system is directly dependent on the quality of the personnel management of medical institutions.
